info.name: Midpage Legal Database Opinions Search API

items.docs:
Search for opinions using semantic (vector), keyword (full-text), or hybrid search.
Search modes: `semantic` (vector similarity using AI embeddings), `keyword` (Elasticsearch full-text with Lexis/Westlaw-style boolean operators), and `hybrid` (semantic + keyword combined with reciprocal rank fusion and deduplication).
Boolean operators (keyword mode only, must be UPPERCASE): AND, OR, NOT, "..." (exact phrase), * and ? (wildcards), W/n (proximity within n words), and () for grouping.
